title: Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support
description: 12 statements rated 1–7 on agreement; significant other, family and friends.

citation.text: Zimet GD, Dahlem NW, Zimet SG, Farley GK (1988). The Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support. Journal of Personality Assessment 52(1):30–41.

scoring.text: Means (1–7): significant other = items 1, 2, 5, 10; family = 3, 4, 8, 11; friends = 6, 7, 9, 12; total = all 12. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
